prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original Adventure World 2 HD 2D game animation sprite sheet, Than motion-a-v1. Input image 1 character reference, input image 2 existing poses reference only. Create a NEW transparent sheet preserving the same young male face, short tousled dark hair, indigo rolled-sleeve robe over cream shirt, rust-red rope sash, charcoal trousers, wrapped sandals, round bronze stove-lid shield with three ember insets. Four columns by four rows, EXACTLY 16 isolated full-body sprites, consistent same scale and ground line within each cell, generous completely transparent gutters and outer margins; each sprite contained entirely within its equal cell. Side three-quarter facing right, full body including shield and feet, crisp HD anime game shading. Row1 IDLE four distinct consecutive breathing frames: settle, inhale, exhale, return. Row2 MOVE four distinct run-cycle frames: right foot forward, passing feet, left foot forward, passing opposite; shield kept on arm, grounded readable silhouette. Row3 MELEE PUNCH four distinct phases: fist drawn back/anticipation, forward drive, fully extended right fist/contact, recovery. Shield on left arm/back, no projectile. Row4 SELF SHIELD CAST four distinct phases: raise shield, kneel and cup ember with free hand, press glowing ember toward shield, rise with shield ready. Original game only no outside IP. Do not reproduce the reference background, no scenery, shadows, text, labels, borders, grids or watermark. Genuine transparent background, not checkerboard art. Keep identity consistent all16, anatomy clean, no clipping, no overlapping cells. Prefer 2048x2048 sheet.
